summary.en: U.S. stocks opened mixed as geopolitical tensions over the Iran Strait of Hormuz eased oil prices, while tech sector showed divergence amid AI chip narrative debates and earnings season noise.
summary.zh: 美股盘前表现分化：随着伊朗霍尔木兹海峡地缘紧张局势缓和导致油价回落，科技股在 AI 芯片叙事争论和财报季噪音中呈现不同走势。

title.en: Oil Prices Slide Below $80 as Gulf Peace Hopes Rise
title.zh: 油价跌破 80 美元，海湾和平预期升温

topNews.impact: Lower oil prices reduce inflation expectations and ease corporate margin pressure, benefiting energy stocks less than tech but supporting discretionary spending sectors.

macroRisk.en: Geopolitical easing reduces oil supply risk premium, supports broader equity valuations via lower inflation expectations.
macroRisk.zh: 地缘缓和降低油价供应风险溢价，通过通胀预期下行支持更广泛的股权估值。

title.en: AMD Beats Q2 Earnings Yet Stock Down 7% - Valuation Concerns Persist
title.zh: AMD 二季报超预期但股价跌约 7%，估值担忧持续

topNews.impact: Market reaction signals high short-term expectations for AI chip leaders; earnings beat alone insufficient without margin expansion narrative.

title.en: Nasdaq and S&P 500 Futures Rise on Diplomatic Relief Hopes
title.zh: 纳指和标普 500 期货上涨，外交缓和预期提振

topNews.impact: Risk-on sentiment from de-escalation risks in Middle East supports big tech, airlines and cyclical discretionary sectors.

title.en: Tesla (TSLA) Under Pressure Amid Broader Tech Rotation
title.zh: 特斯拉股价受压力，科技股板块轮动

topNews.impact: EV sector faces near-term volatility; broader market weakness in AI narrative detracts from consumer electronics and autonomous driving valuations.

title.en: Palantir (PLTR) Earnings Watch: AI Platform Expansion in Focus
title.zh: 关注 Palantir 财报：AI 平台扩张成焦点

topNews.impact: Key bellwether for data analytics and defense IT spending; strong demand signals institutional AI adoption beyond hype.

title.en: Gold Holds Above $2,300 Despite Dollar Strength
title.zh: 金价持稳在 2,300 美元以上，尽管美元走强

topNews.impact: Safe-haven demand from geopolitical concerns supports precious metals; gold miners could benefit if yields stay elevated.

title.en: Treasury 10Y Yield Stabilizes Near Key Technical Levels
title.zh: 美债 10 年期收益率在关键技术水平附近企稳

topNews.impact: Bond market positioning critical for rate-sensitive sectors; yield stability supports mortgage-backed and REIT valuations.

ai.en: Mixed sentiment with earnings noise; NVDA rally offset by AMD underperformance. AI chip demand remains strong but short-term expectations elevated.
ai.zh: AI 板块情绪分化，财报噪音干扰：英伟达上涨抵消了AMD疲软。尽管芯片需求强劲，但短期预期过高导致波动加剧

semiconductor.en: Divergent performance: AMD disappointed despite earnings beat, signaling high expectations for next quarter. Memory chips (WAFERS/MXLC) still strong.
semiconductor.zh: 表现分化：AMD财报超预期但股价下跌，暗示市场对下一季度的期望已非常高。存储芯片仍受强劲需求支撑

bigTech.en: Big Tech names benefit from risk-on; MSFT/GOOGL outperform on AI cloud revenue. Consumer tech faces EV rotation pressure.
bigTech.zh: 大型科技公司受益于风险偏好提升；微软谷歌在AI云收入上跑赢，而消费电子面临电动车板块轮动的压制

energy.en: Oil slide supports energy cost-sensitive sectors but weighs on XLE. Renewable transition stocks underperform amid traditional oil rally.
energy.zh: 油价下跌利好能源敏感型部门但压制了XLE ETF；传统油企反弹拖累新能源转型股票

ev.en: TSLA and legacy auto EV segments face pressure. Rivian offers relative value opportunity but near-term volatility likely.
ev.zh: 特斯拉及传统车企电动车业务承压。Rivian 提供相对价值机会，但短期波动不可避免

market.en: Broad market mixed; futures suggest moderate open with potential midday weakness if yield spike occurs. Defensive rotation possible.
market.zh: 大盘表现分化；期货显示可能温和开盘，若收益率飙升则午后或走弱。防御性板块轮动机会浮现

preciousMetals.en: Gold remains elevated despite mixed market; geopolitical hedging supports miners. Silver lags gold in technical terms.
preciousMetals.zh: 金价在分化市场中依然坚挺；地缘避险支撑矿业股。银价技术上相对黄金落后

oil.en: WTI below $80 on Gulf diplomatic progress; downside risk limited but upside depends on renewed supply shocks.
oil.zh: 受海湾外交进展影响 WTI 跌破 80 美元；下行空间有限，上行取决于新的供应冲击

futures.en: S&P futures flat to +0.2%; Nasdaq up ~+0.4% driven by AI chip rally hopes; Dow mixed with industrial stocks lagging.
futures.zh: 标普期货平盘至微涨 0.2%；纳指受芯片反弹预期推动上涨约 0.4%，道指表现分化工业股拖累

treasury10Y.en: ~3.85-3.9%, stabilized after recent volatility; watch for upward break above resistance.
treasury10Y.zh: 收益率在 3.85%-3.9%区间企稳，波动后暂稳；需警惕突破上方阻力位

dxy.en: ~96-97, relatively stable; geopolitical calm supports dollar but safe-haven flows could reverse if tensions flare.
dxy.zh: 美元指数在 96-97区间相对平稳；地缘缓和支撑美元但若局势突变避险流可能逆转

oil.en: $74-80 range as Gulf diplomacy deescalates; downside capped at $73 if supply fears return.
oil.zh: 油价在 74-80区间震荡；地缘缓和压制下行空间，供应担忧重燃前下方支撑

keyRisk.en: Elevated AI chip valuations + potential earnings miss; geopolitical shock (war escalation or new conflict) could trigger sharp sell-off.
keyRisk.zh: 高企的AI芯片估值叠加财报风险；地缘政治突发事件（冲突升级）可能引发抛售

note.en: Market shows divergence between tech/AI optimism and earnings pressure. Geopolitical easing supports but oil weakness keeps some investors cautious about discretionary spending.
note.zh: 市场呈现分化：科技股乐观与财报压力并存。地缘缓和提供支撑但油价疲软使部分投资者对可选消费谨慎

disclaimer.en: Data compiled from public sources; market commentary reflects synthesis of available headlines and macro logic.
disclaimer.zh: 数据来源于公开渠道；市场点评基于已有头条新闻与宏观逻辑的综合研判
